description: The fluent, blocking HTTP client for Spring MVC applications and virtual threads.
The non-blocking reactive HTTP client built on Project Reactor for WebFlux applications.
A fluent hook that turns chosen HTTP statuses into the application's own exceptions.
A connect and read limit so a slow service cannot hold a thread indefinitely.
A small class per remote service that exposes a domain method and hides HTTP details.
A test double such as MockRestServiceServer or WireMock that simulates responses, delays and failures.
